lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible in a semi-regular staggered grid arrangement across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are perceptible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form identifiable grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity above and a shadow-induced lower intensity below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white, hook-shaped or L-shaped anomalous mark is visible on the dorsal surface, posterior to the head and superior to the primary lateral flank constellation.
